description: This PHP file handles AJAX requests for resetting/restoring device settings, including reboot, Wi-Fi reset, factory reset, and password reset operations. It includes utility functions for managing MAC filtering tables and performs validation on input parameters.

methods.name: delMacFilterTable
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for a given SSID list and disables filters.

methods.name: delMacFilterTables
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for predefined SSID list 1 to 6.
